Manufacturing, Quality and Process Team

A global healthcare company faced an urgent need to recommission, qualify, and reopen a critical manufacturing site to produce COVID-19 test kits. The rapid surge in COVID-19 variant cases created a significant demand for testing, and this site was responsible for supplying 100% of the test kits distributed worldwide. To meet this challenge, the client required a team of over 20 skilled Quality, Manufacturing, and Process Engineers to execute the project swiftly and effectively.

Viltis rapidly mobilized its resources to identify, vet, and deploy a specialized team of experts tailored to the client’s needs. Within a condensed timeline, Viltis assembled and delivered a team of over 20 experienced professionals with the required technical and regulatory expertise.

These engineers worked collaboratively to recommission and qualify the site, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and readiness for high-volume production. Viltis' ability to efficiently onboard and integrate the team enabled the client to begin scaling operations without delay, meeting the urgent production demands.

The Viltis team successfully supported the recommissioning and qualification process, ensuring the manufacturing site became fully operational on schedule. This allowed the client to rapidly ramp up production of COVID-19 test kits, meeting critical global demand.

Through Viltis’ expert deployment and coordination, the client was able to reopen their manufacturing site under an accelerated timeline. The project ensured a consistent supply of COVID-19 test kits, playing a vital role in the global response to the pandemic and helping to address a public health crisis.
